article.story: NATCHITOCHES, La. -- — Kordrick Turner had 12 points in Northwestern State’s 71-57 win against West Florida on Wednesday. Turner also contributed seven rebounds and three blocks for the Demons (2-5). Antoine Almuttar, Kai Simpson and Kordrick Turner each scored 12 points. Isaiah Alexander led the Argonauts (3-5) with 13 points and seven rebounds. West Florida got 12 points and two steals from Alex Godley Jr. Daylon Dickerson had 11 points, seven rebounds and two steals. Up next Up next for Northwestern State is a Tuesday matchup with Ecclesia at home, and West Florida plays Florida State on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
